Elvis Presley – Jailhouse Rock / Treat Me Nice

Original 1957 RCA Victor 45 RPM single featuring two classic Elvis Presley recordings from the MGM motion picture Jailhouse Rock.

A cornerstone of any rock & roll collection and a must-have for Elvis collectors.

Record Details

  • Artist: Elvis Presley
  • Title: Jailhouse Rock
  • B-Side: Treat Me Nice
  • Label: RCA Victor
  • Catalog Number: 47-7035
  • Format: 7" Vinyl Single
  • Speed: 45 RPM
  • Country: USA
  • Year: 1957
  • Black RCA Victor "New Orthophonic High Fidelity" label

Track Listing

Side A

  • Jailhouse Rock – 2:30

Side B

  • Treat Me Nice – 2:02

Condition

Vinyl: Fair

  • Original vintage pressing with good shine.
  • Light scratches and scuffs consistent with age and normal play.
  • Labels show handling wear and a small inventory sticker on the A-side label.
  • No cracks or major defects noted.

Sleeve:

  • Ships in a new white paper sleeve with a protective poly outer sleeve.
